# B2B Social Asset Automation Goal

## Goal statement

Create a designer-owned, automated B2B asset system that enables marketers to produce all standard B2B marketing assets independently while ensuring every output is on brand, placement-ready and compliant with Meta safe zones.

## One-sentence vision

Enable B2B marketers to create every standard marketing asset themselves, while a designer-owned system—not repeated manual review—protects the ImmoScout24 brand.

## Desired future state

- B2B marketers can produce standard assets without opening a Creative Studio ticket.
- Brand-critical design decisions are embedded in locked templates, components and validation rules.
- Assets that pass all critical checks can be approved automatically.
- Designers focus on brand stewardship, system maintenance, new creative frameworks and genuine exceptions.
- Creative Studio retains visibility over what is produced without reviewing every asset manually.

## Proposed success measures

The following are initial six-month targets and should be confirmed after measuring the current baseline:

- 90% of B2B social assets created without direct designer involvement
- 100% of assets created through the approved system
- 95% first-pass brand-compliance rate
- 80% reduction in routine design tickets
- 70% reduction in feedback rounds
- Standard assets available within one working day
- Zero published assets with critical brand or safe-zone violations

## Non-negotiable guardrails

Marketers cannot change:

- Brand colours
- Typography
- Logo versions, proportions, placement or clear space
- Approved highlighter styles
- Image style and image-selection rules
- Layout grids and spacing rules
- Placement safe zones
- CTA styling
- Mandatory legal content
- Export dimensions and technical settings

Marketers may change only controlled content, such as:

- Headlines and body copy within defined length limits
- Campaign information, dates, locations and statistics
- Approved CTA wording
- Images from an approved library
- Predefined product or content modules

## Approval model

### Automatically approve

Approve assets that use the approved system and pass every critical brand, content, technical and safe-zone check.

### Automatically block

Block assets with an off-brand colour, font, logo, image treatment, highlighter, layout, safe-zone violation, missing mandatory content, text overflow or incorrect export specification.

The system should explain exactly what must be corrected rather than returning a general “off-brand” message.

### Escalate to a designer

Escalate work that requires:

- A new campaign concept or visual direction
- A new template or content type
- A brand exception
- Bespoke illustration, motion or art direction
- Sensitive claims, legal judgement or unusual accessibility requirements

## Ownership

Creative Studio designers own:

- Brand rules and governance
- Templates and reusable modules
- Approved asset libraries
- Automated validation criteria
- Exception handling
- Ongoing quality monitoring
- System improvements

B2B marketers own:

- Providing complete content and campaign information
- Using only the approved creation workflow
- Correcting issues identified by the system
- Escalating genuine exceptions instead of working outside the system

## Brand-monitoring approach

Creative Studio should monitor the system through regular reporting rather than reviewing every asset. Reporting should include:

- Number of assets created
- Automatic approval and failure rates
- Most frequent violations
- Most-used templates
- Manually overridden or escalated assets
- A small sample of approved outputs for qualitative review

## Definition of done

The goal is achieved when B2B marketers can reliably create and publish standard assets through the approved system, critical violations are automatically prevented, and designers can protect and evolve the brand without becoming a production or approval bottleneck.
